posts.content_md: I need IR blocking material for some of my DPSS lasers that aren't filtered. I prefer a plastic sheet that can be easily cut. Any ideas where to buy it?

posts.author: DJ Mathson
posts.content_md:
Not sure where you can find plastic filters, but here are some links to glass filters:

[http://www.novalasers.com/NOVAstore/pc/ ... product=68](http://www.novalasers.com/NOVAstore/pc/viewPrd.asp?idcategory=6&idproduct=68)

[http://www.optics-online.com/irc.asp](http://www.optics-online.com/irc.asp)

[http://www.edmundoptics.com/onlinecatal ... 8&search=1](http://www.edmundoptics.com/onlinecatalog/displayproduct.cfm?productID=1328&search=1)

[http://cgi.ebay.com/10-pieces-IR-Filter ... 20ada6c0b0](http://cgi.ebay.com/10-pieces-IR-Filter-lot_W0QQitemZ140352340144QQcmdZViewItemQQptZLH_DefaultDomain_0?hash=item20ada6c0b0)

You can also find filters in webcams or digital cameras.
